j.mix1.mix.1=0: Mixer knob 1 is at 0, so nothing patched here reaches the filter. Turn knob 1 up.

j.mix2.init: Mixer knob 2 is at 0, so nothing patched here reaches the filter. Turn knob 2 up.

j.mix3.init: Mixer knob 3 is at 0, so nothing patched here reaches the filter. Turn knob 3 up.

j.rev_in.rev.mix=0: REVERB MIX is at 0, so only the dry signal is heard, and that is now whatever is patched here. Turn MIX up to hear the reverb.

j.osc1_pwm.init: Oscillator 1 is not on the square or narrow pulse wave, and pulse width only changes those. Switch its WAVEFORM to one of them.

j.audio_in.init: Mixer knob 3 is at 0, so nothing patched here reaches the filter. Turn knob 3 up.
